fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole pickup truck, which we can detail.
findings: Black paint on the driver side doors and bed shows hazy, dull areas and visible streaking in the sunlight
Black tailgate looks dull and lacks depth, with light marks around the handle
Hood and front fenders show uneven gloss and dust on the black paint
Lower doors and rocker area along the driver side look grimy and dusty
Gauge cluster lens and surrounding dash trim look dusty
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 2011 Silverado. The black paint on the driver side and tailgate looks a bit hazy and streaky in the photos, and black shows that more than any other color. We do pre-sale details including a machine buff and interior clean, and we come to you. Would you like a quote?
